name: PromioSync
author: wjddesigns

sections.description:
Promio Sync is a powerful WordPress plugin that connects parent and child sites for synchronized promo and coupon management. Perfect for franchise networks, multi-location businesses, and marketing agencies.

Key Features

  • Visual Drag & Drop Builder – Create stunning promos with headings, text, buttons, icons, images, columns, and more
  • Real-Time Sync – Push updates instantly to all connected child sites
  • Smart Scheduling – Set start/end dates with recurring schedules
  • Child Site Overrides – Let franchisees customize without losing parent updates
  • Responsive Layouts – Works beautifully on desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Override Reports – See exactly what child sites have customized

Perfect For

  • Franchise networks
  • Multi-location businesses
  • Marketing agencies managing multiple client sites
  • Any WordPress network needing centralized promo control

How It Works

  1. Install Promio Sync on your parent site (headquarters)
  2. Create promos using the visual builder
  3. Connect your child sites (franchise locations)
  4. Promos sync automatically – updates push instantly!

Free vs Pro

Free version includes:

  • Full visual promo builder
  • All modules (headings, text, buttons, images, columns, etc.)
  • 1 child site connection
  • Manual promo activation

Pro version adds:

  • More child sites (5, 15, or unlimited)
  • Advanced scheduling with start/end dates
  • Recurring schedules (daily, weekly, monthly, seasonal)
  • Priority support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/promiosync directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Promio Sync in the admin menu.
  4. Choose whether this is a Parent Site or Child Site.
  5. For parent sites, create promos and generate API keys for child sites.
  6. For child sites, enter the parent site URL and API key to connect.
sections.faq:
What is a parent site vs child site?

The parent site is where you create and manage promos (usually your headquarters or main site). Child sites are the locations that receive and display the synced promos (franchise locations, regional sites, etc.).

Can child sites customize promos?

Yes! Child sites can override specific modules (like changing a phone number or address) while still receiving updates from the parent site for non-overridden content.

How many child sites can I connect?

The free version allows 1 child site. Pro licenses allow 5, 15, or unlimited child sites depending on your plan.

Does it work with page builders?

Promio Sync uses shortcodes to display promos, which work with any theme or page builder. You can place [promio id="123"] anywhere on your site.

What happens if I disconnect a child site?

The promos will remain on the child site but will no longer receive updates from the parent. You can reconnect at any time.
